scope: Q01 accuracy metrics and Q02 base/small performance metrics using production domain prompt v1

corpus.selectionRule: For browser download-name collisions, select the last saved candidate by LastWriteTime; retain every original file.

decodingProfile.initial_prompt: 无人机，无人艇，协同搜索，协同航迹，改进蛙跳算法，粒子群优化，全局最优解，运行时引用，运行代次，展示绑定，编队控制，动态避障，航向角速度，经纬度，遥测，场景就绪，帧应用回执，幂等请求，命令序列，WebGL，实时因子，峰值内存，九十五分位延迟

replication.reason: The default confidence-based temperature fallback may vary across distinct inference requests. Java idempotency still replays the cached result for the same request key.

conclusion.note: Domain prompt v1 materially improves this project corpus. The prompt was tuned on this corpus, so this is project tuning evidence rather than an independent generalization claim.

privacy: No audio, reference text, recognized text, credentials, private paths, or model weights are included.
